why: Runs that wrote events but never recorded their coverage, and whose heartbeats were overwritten before recover_abandoned_run() existed. Their observed time is permanently uncountable. Listed here so the health check stops warning about a fact that cannot change, and so the fact itself stays on the record rather than disappearing with the warning.
consequence: Their collected hours are absent from the coverage total, which understates coverage. That is the conservative direction, and it is left uncorrected: recovering the span from event timestamps would be an inferred measurement, and this project does not credit itself for time it cannot show it observed.
fixed_by: recover_abandoned_run(), FINDINGS M1-T8f. No run after 2026-08-23 can join this list.

runs.cause: Cancelled by hand while the unlinked-file data loss of M1-T8b was being diagnosed.
Ended without writing its coverage row. The 351-minute hole this left in the record is what led to the recovery mechanism existing at all.
In flight when the fix was written; its heartbeat predated the `started` field, so there was nothing to bound a recovered row with.
